# Web Prod Skills

> Open-source production-readiness toolkit for AI coding agents and web engineering teams building web applications.

Website: https://hari7261.github.io/web-prod-skills/
Repository: https://github.com/hari7261/web-prod-skills
License: MIT

## Contents
- Agent contract and mandatory production-readiness Definition of Done (`AGENTS.md`).
- 49 modular skills across frontend, backend, AI features, integrations, cross-cutting, and delivery.
- 27 executable gates across pre-commit, pre-merge, pre-deploy, and post-deploy stages with pass/fail fixtures.
- 11 engineering knowledge baselines, 8 starter template suites, golden eval datasets/rubrics/runner, and CLI scripts.
- GitHub Actions CI, nightly eval sweep, Pages deployment, and tagged release workflows.

## Limitations
Static heuristic gates and report-validating gates complement—never replace—application-specific runtime unit, integration, security, and canary tests in consuming projects.
